author: nemi
title: My Taxi Got Hit 5 Minutes From the Airport
story_evidence: Five minutes from SFO, the ordinary human-driven taxi is rear-ended while Nemi is in the back seat; script turns 11–14 and inspected actual film contact sheets. Luggage/flight motif and extreme perspective are original promotional exaggeration, not filmed events.
application: Original enormous low-angle rear taxi and foreshortened incoming nose, dominant canonical shocked face integrated above rear trunk/windshield, off-kilter travel motifs and compact reaction balloon. All supporting vehicle/scenery geometry is newly authored; no TravelArt side-view car geometry, bridge collision, injury, driver redraw or Waymo accident claim.
